IDENTITY AMBIGUITY: the assigned website deleeuwrijschool.nl publishes self-written testimonials naming instructor 'Johannes de Leeuw' with overwhelmingly Frisian student surnames (van der Meulen, Sjoerdsma, Jellema, Kimsma, Vosman, Pruiksma, Boersma, Kuiper) and matches the separate Leeuwarden 'Autorijschool De Leeuw' (88% pass, rijlessen.nl) - this is very likely a DIFFERENT (Friesland) De Leeuw rijschool, NOT the Vught one. Quotes captured are from this site and are non-independent, unverifiable one-liners; treat with strong caution.
Do NOT confuse with 'LEEUW Opleidingen' Eindhoven (268-436 reviews, founded 1962, truck/taxi/motor CCV school) - a separate business whose reviews are unrelated to the Vught school.
Captured quotes are short generic thank-you one-liners ('Bedankt voor de leuke lessen', 'JAAA! Dankjewel') with no exam-day, faalangst, or concrete detail.
